## Interests
Ecology and Environmental Justice

## Education
University of Michigan, Mechanical Engineering

## Bio: 
My background is in hardware-based and some simulation-based mechanical engineering work. I studied this field as an undergraduate and worked as a mechanical engineer at a carbon capture start-up company based in Southeast Michigan. My professional inclinations and experiences are engineering focused, but my interests and personal passions center ecological/environmental/earth studies and education. I am excited to spend time building skills in my areas of personal interest and find ways to weave these into my professional work.
